```{r}
#------- import data -------#
# NOTE: run asv_curation_18S.R first -- it produces
# results/tax_filled_2023_18S.csv, which is what this chunk reads below.

# Sequence count table (path relative to repository root)
otutab3 <- read.csv("data/asv_otu_rl_2023_18S.csv", check.names = F)
rownames(otutab3)<- otutab3[,1]
otutab3 <- otutab3[,2:46]
otutab3 <- otu_table(otutab3, taxa_are_rows = T)

# Sequence taxonomy classifications -- curated (Taxa/taxa2-filled) table
# produced by asv_curation_18S.R, NOT the raw data/asv_tax_rl_2023_18S.csv
# (which has two fewer columns: no filled "Taxa" or "taxa2" fields).
tax3 <- read.csv("results/tax_filled_2023_18S.csv", header=T)
rownames(tax3)<- taxa_names(otutab3)
tax3 <- tax3[,2:12]
tax3 <- as.matrix(tax3)
tax3 <- tax_table(tax3)
taxa_names(tax3) <- taxa_names(otutab3)

# Sample metadata -- data/ossining_meta.csv is the correct source; see
# metadata_utils.R for how the "Name2" (18S sample-name key), Month, and
# Date_Sam columns are derived from the existing SampleID/Date columns.
source("metadata_utils.R")
meta3 <- load_ossining_meta("data/ossining_meta.csv")
meta3 <- meta3[meta3$Year == 2023, ]
meta3 <- make_sample_name(meta3, domain_prefix = "18S", name_col = "Name2")
meta3 <- sample_data(meta3)
rownames(meta3) <- meta3$Name2
# Load table, tax, and metadata into phyloseq object
physeq_18S23 <- merge_phyloseq(otutab3, tax3, meta3)

# remove samples with zero counts
physeq_18S23 <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_18S23) >= 1, physeq_18S23)

# remove chloroplasts
#physeq_18S23 <- subset_taxa(physeq_18S23, Order!="Chloroplast")
```

```{r}
#------- alpha diversity measures -------#
library("microbiome")
library("knitr")
alpha18S23 <- microbiome::alpha(physeq_18S23)
write.csv(alpha18S23, "results/ossining23-18S_alpha-diversity-2.csv")

#------- plot richness -------#
jpeg("figs/richplot18S_23-2.jpg",width = 10, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot_richness(physeq_18S23, x = "Date_Sam", measures="Observed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=60, hjust=1)) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())

jpeg("figs/richplot18S_23_lake-2.jpg",width = 10, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot_richness(physeq_18S23, x = "Date_Sam", measures="Observed", title = "18S 2023 richness") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=60, hjust=1)) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank()) +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")

rich.plot18S <- plot_richness(physeq_18S23, x = "Date_Sam", measures="Observed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=60, hjust=1)) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())

#------- Division bar plot -------#
p_18S23 <- subset_taxa(physeq_18S23) %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Taxa2") %>%                     #agglomerate to edited division level
  transform_sample_counts(function(x){x/sum(x)}) %>%   #transform to relative abundance
  psmelt()
write.csv(p_18S23, "results/ossining23-18S_division-2.csv")

library(dplyr)
relabund_table_18S2023Division <- p_18S23 %>%
  group_by(Lake, Month, Date_Sam, Taxa2) %>%
  summarize(RelAbund = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(relabund_table_18S2023Division,
          "results/ossining23-18S_relative_abundance_division-2.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

colourCount = length(unique(p_18S23$Taxa2))
getPalette = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))

phyplot_18S23 <- ggplot(arrange(p_18S23, Taxa2), aes(x=Date_Sam, y=Abundance, fill=Taxa2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size=10, hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=10)) +
  ylab("Relative Read Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = getPalette(colourCount)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = c(0,0))+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 2))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))

phyplot_18S23 +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9))

#SAVE PLOTS:
jpeg("figs/divplot18S-2.jpg",width = 12, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
ggplot(arrange(p_18S23, Taxa2), aes(x=Date_Sam, y=Abundance, fill=Taxa2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size=10, hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=10)) +
  ylab("Relative Read Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = getPalette(colourCount)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = c(0,0))+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 2))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))

jpeg("figs/lake_divplot18S-2.jpg",width = 14, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
phyplot_18S23 +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9)) + plot_annotation ("18S 2023 Relative Read Abundance")

#save as svg
ggsave("figs/lake_divplot18S_22-2.svg",width = 14, height =8, units = "in")
phyplot_18S23 +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9)) + plot_annotation ("18S 2023 Relative Read Abundance")
```

```{r}

#------- PCoA  -------#

LM_18S23

#sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 15 samples by 13 sample variables ]

#scale to even depth
LM_18S23rare <- rarefy_even_depth(LM_18S23)
LM_18S23rare
```

```{r}
#------PERMANOVA--------#
#FOR MOHEGAN
#bray curtis on rarified physeq
LMbray18S23 <- phyloseq::distance(LM_18S23rare, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
LMdf18S23 <- data.frame(sample_data(LM_18S23rare))
#PERMANOVA with bray curtis in formula and data as dataframe
LMperm18S23 <- adonis2(LMbray18S23~Month, data=LMdf18S23)
#check output
LMperm18S23
#NOT significant

#FOR RIPPOWAM
#bray curtis on rarified physeq
LRbray18S23 <- phyloseq::distance(LR_18S23rare, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
LRdf18S23 <- data.frame(sample_data(LR_18S23rare))
#PERMANOVA with bray curtis in formula and data as dataframe
LRperm18S23 <- adonis2(LRbray18S23~Month, data=LRdf18S23)
#check output
LRperm18S23
#significant!

#FOR TEATOWN
#bray curtis on rarified physeq
TTLbray18S23 <- phyloseq::distance(TTL_18S23rare, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
TTLdf18S23 <- data.frame(sample_data(TTL_18S23rare))
#PERMANOVA with bray curtis in formula and data as dataframe
TTLperm18S23 <- adonis2(TTLbray18S23~Month, data=TTLdf18S23)
#check output
TTLperm18S23
#significant!

#ALL LAKES: physeq_18S23
#scale to even depth
Lake23rare18 <- rarefy_even_depth(physeq_18S23)
Lake23rare18
#phyloseq-class experiment-level object
#otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 2469 taxa and 45 samples ]
#sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 45 samples by 13 sample variables ]
#tax_table()   Taxonomy Table:    [ 2469 taxa by 11 taxonomic ranks ]
sample_sums(Lake23rare18) #6964

#bray curtis on rarified physeq
Lake23bray18 <- phyloseq::distance(Lake23rare18, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
Lake23df18 <- data.frame(sample_data(Lake23rare18))
#PERMANOVA with bray curtis in formula and data as dataframe
Lake23perm18 <- adonis2(Lake23bray18~Lake*Month, data=Lake23df18, by="terms")
#check output
Lake23perm18
#All combinations significant!
```

```{r}
#PAIRWISE TESTING FOLLOWING PERMANOVA

#LR,TTL significant -> pairwise comparison post hoc

LRdf18S23$Month=as.factor(LRdf18S23$Month)
LRpairwise18S23 <- adonis_pairwise(x=LRdf18S23, dd=LRbray18S23, group.var="Month")
LRpairwise18S23
#Aug/June, Aug/Sept, July/June, July/Sept, June/Sept significant -> not Aug/July

TTLdf18S23$Month=as.factor(TTLdf18S23$Month)
TTLpairwise18S23 <- adonis_pairwise(x=TTLdf18S23, dd=TTLbray18S23, group.var="Month")
TTLpairwise18S23
#Aug/July significant -> not Aug/June, Aug/Sept, July/June, June/Sept, July/Sept

#All lake significant lake*month (all 3 interactions) -> pairwise comparison post hoc

Lake23df18$Month=as.factor(Lake23df18$Month)
Lake23df18$Lake=as.factor(Lake23df18$Lake)
Lake23pairwise18 <- adonis_pairwise(x=Lake23df18, dd=Lake23bray18, group.var="Lake")
Lake23pairwise18
#LM/LR, LR/TTL significant
Month23pairwise18 <- adonis_pairwise(x=Lake23df18, dd=Lake23bray18, group.var="Month")
Month23pairwise18
# June/sept, july/sept significant -> not aug/july, aug/june, aug/sep, july/june
```


```{r}
#------HOMOGENEITY OF MULTIVARIATE DISPERSION (PERMDISP)------#
# Run this BEFORE trusting each PERMANOVA result above
# if significant, run TukeyHSD

#FOR MOHEGAN
LMdisp18S23 <- betadisper(LMbray18S23, LMdf18S23$Month)
permutest(LMdisp18S23, permutations = 999)
#not significant

#FOR RIPPOWAM
LRdisp18S23 <- betadisper(LRbray18S23, LRdf18S23$Month)
permutest(LRdisp18S23, permutations = 999)
#not significant

#FOR TEATOWN
TTLdisp18S23 <- betadisper(TTLbray18S23, TTLdf18S23$Month)
permutest(TTLdisp18S23, permutations = 999)
# SIGNIFICANT
TukeyHSD(TTLdisp18S23)
# all but Sept-Aug and June-July significant

#ALL LAKES: physeq_18S23
#Lake23perm18 used Lake*Month, so check dispersion for EACH factor separately
#betadisper only takes one grouping factor at a time

#dispersion by Lake
Lake23disp_Lake <- betadisper(Lake23bray18, Lake23df18$Lake)
permutest(Lake23disp_Lake, permutations = 999)
#SIGNIFICANT
TukeyHSD(Lake23disp_Lake)
#TTL/LR significant

#dispersion by Month
Lake23disp_Month <- betadisper(Lake23bray18, Lake23df18$Month)
permutest(Lake23disp_Month, permutations = 999)
#not significant

#dispersion by the Lake:Month interaction (combine factors into one grouping variable)
```
